title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1982-05-21
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:96330) SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD; CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:109334) (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell XLII-S90); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a fine 1982 show with standout Playing In The Band → Uncle John's Band segue and superb Wheel/Black Peter segment.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the performance highly, highlighting the seamless transition from Playing In The Band into Uncle John's Band as well as strong renditions of The Wheel and Black Peter. The matrix mix by Dave Usborne is praised for its joy‑filled fidelity, making the show a pleasure to listen to despite the unknown date.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 4 stars and focus on positive musical moments and high‑fidelity matrix mix; limited number of reviews reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High fidelity praised; the Usborne matrix mix is described as a joy with superb balance and clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note an especially cool segue from Playing In The Band into Uncle John's Band and a strong, cohesive second‑half featuring The Wheel and Black Peter.
